title: Soft Gluon Wave Function and Evolution Operator in the CGC at Next-to-Leading Order
summary: We construct the soft gluon light cone wave function of a fast moving hadron and the associated unitary evolution operator $Ω$ up to $\mathcal{O}(g^{2})$ in pure Yang Mills theory $(N_{f} = 0)$, within the Color Glass Condensate (CGC) framework. Working in light cone gauge, we perform a Born Oppenheimer separation between fast valence and soft modes and implement the eikonal approximation, which allows $Ω$ to be written as a fully normal ordered series in soft gluon creation and annihilation operators. The expansion coefficients are functionals of the non-commuting valence color charge…
